title: VendPoint Merchandising Rules — Selections and Planogram Changes
content:
Merchandising rules for the selections of machines under the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program.

## Rules in force

**M1 Special items and capacity.** A selection holds a non-catalog special item only while the machine's special items stay within the model's special item selections, and the machine never holds more items than its selection capacity.

**M2 Planogram review.** At each planogram review, every planogram review interval in months, Corbett removes selections with no vend for the model's slow-mover removal days, recorded as changes from Corbett with the removal reason slow mover; Corbett-initiated changes never count toward the included changes.

## Rule no longer in force

The following rule is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis for customer selection changes on VendPoint machines:

> "The customer may ask to add items, change par quantities or remove items at any time on an active machine; changes take effect at the next restock visit."

## Points of judgement

| Fact | Under M1 and M2 |
|---|---|
| A special item would bring the machine's special items above the model's special item selections | The selection does not hold it |
| An addition would bring the items held above the selection capacity | The machine never holds more items than its capacity |
| A selection has had no vend for the slow-mover removal days at a review | Corbett removes it at that review |
| A change was made by Corbett | It never counts toward the included changes |

### Hypothetical case

On a model allowing 4 special item selections and holding 4 special items, a fifth special item is not held. On a model with 90 slow-mover days, a selection last vended 95 days before a review is removed at that review; one last vended 60 days before is not. The figures are examples.

superseded_clauses: The customer may ask to add items, change par quantities or remove items at any time on an active machine; changes take effect at the next restock visit.
